description: Dashboard product usage/error reporting moves from the IDE telemetry transport to direct Azure Monitor export, so reporting now works for CLI-launched, standalone, and deployed dashboards without an IDE debug session or OpenTelemetry Collector. Dashboard product telemetry no longer honors IDE telemetry consent; set `ASPIRE_DASHBOARD_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=true` to opt out instead.
name: Migrate Dashboard product telemetry to Azure Monitor
